result.provenance_markdown:
# Provenance: MD setup for PDB 1AKI

Every setting in the `*.mdp` files, and the choices `run.sh` makes, is in
this table with where it came from (a test maps each mdp key to a row): **measured** (from the assay behind a cited kinetic constant, or the
deposited structure), **chosen** (a labelled default), or **method** (a
published model or algorithm, cited).

| parameter | value | origin | source |
|---|---|---|---|
| temperature | 298.15 K | chosen | chosen: 25 C, no measured value supplied |
| pH (protonation) | standard states | chosen | not stated; GROMACS assigns standard protonation states |
| ionic strength | 0.15 M NaCl, net charge neutralised | chosen | physiological default; override with --ionic-strength |
| pressure | 1.0 bar | chosen | ambient |
| production length | 10 ns | chosen | override with --ns |
| replicas | 3 | chosen | independent runs from one solvated, minimised system, differing only in their initial velocities; every quantity is reported as a spread across them |
| velocity seed | rep1: 20260927, rep2: 20260928, rep3: 20260929 | chosen | fixed so each run can be reproduced; ion placement uses 20260927 for all replicas, so they share one starting structure |
| force field | amber99sb-ildn | method | Lindorff-Larsen et al. (2010) Proteins 78:1950, doi:10.1002/prot.22711 |
| water model | tip3p | method | Jorgensen et al. (1983) J. Chem. Phys. 79:926, doi:10.1063/1.445869 |
| thermostat | V-rescale, tau 0.1 ps | method | Bussi, Donadio & Parrinello (2007) J. Chem. Phys. 126:014101, doi:10.1063/1.2408420 |
| barostat (equilibration) | C-rescale, tau 2 ps | method | Bernetti & Bussi (2020) J. Chem. Phys. 153:114107, doi:10.1063/5.0020514 |
| barostat (production) | Parrinello-Rahman, tau 2 ps | method | Parrinello & Rahman (1981) J. Appl. Phys. 52:7182, doi:10.1063/1.328693 |
| electrostatics | PME, 1.0 nm real-space cut-off | method | Essmann et al. (1995) J. Chem. Phys. 103:8577, doi:10.1063/1.470117 (ions.mdp, which only places ions and simulates nothing, uses a plain cut-off: the system is still charged then) |
| PME grid | 0.16 nm spacing, 4th-order interpolation | chosen | GROMACS's defaults for PME accuracy |
| van der Waals | 1.0 nm cut-off, dispersion correction to energy and pressure | chosen | the cut-off the force field was parameterised with |
| neighbour list | Verlet buffer, updated every 10 steps | chosen | GROMACS default; the buffer is sized automatically |
| compressibility | 4.5e-5 1/bar | chosen | isothermal compressibility of water near 300 K |
| minimisation | steepest descent to max force < 1000 kJ/mol/nm, at most 50000 steps | chosen | standard pre-equilibration target |
| equilibration | NVT 100 ps then NPT 100 ps, protein heavy atoms restrained | chosen | restraints released for production |
| output | coordinates every 10 ps; energies and log every 2 ps | chosen | enough to analyse, small enough to keep |
| constraints | h-bonds, LINCS; 2 fs time step | method | Hess et al. (1997) J. Comput. Chem. 18:1463, doi:10.1002/(SICI)1096-987X(199709)18:12<1463::AID-JCC4>3.0.CO;2-H |
| engine | GROMACS | method | Abraham et al. (2015) SoftwareX 1-2:19, doi:10.1016/j.softx.2015.06.001 |
| structure | PDB 1AKI, chain A | measured | Berman et al. (2000) Nucleic Acids Res. 28:235, doi:10.1093/nar/28.1.235; entry doi:10.2210/pdb1aki/pdb |

## What this setup does not do

- **Small molecules are stripped.** `run.sh` removes every HETATM record and
  prints what it removed. A substrate, inhibitor or cofactor needs its own
  topology (for example from ACPYPE/GAFF or CGenFF) before it can be
  simulated; none is invented here.
- **Protonation.** No assay pH was supplied, so the standard protonation states pdb2gmx assigns are an assumption, not a measurement.
- **Replicas.** 3 runs, seeds 20260927, 20260928, 20260929.
  Report every quantity as a spread across them (`caterva md --summarise`); a mean without that spread is one number pretending to be a result.
- **Length.** 10 ns samples side-chain and loop motion. It does not
  sample catalysis, and a kcat cannot be read off it.

## Stages

energy minimisation (steepest descent) -> NVT 100 ps (position restraints)
-> NPT 100 ps (C-rescale, restraints) -> production 10 ns
(Parrinello-Rahman), all at 298.15 K.
